items.en_title: Taubaté (SP) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 20 #13
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Taubaté (SP) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento); proposals close Nov 20, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
